newsitem.title: USA: Sen Domenici sees possible trouble for Pena post.
newsitem.headline: Sen Domenici sees possible trouble for Pena post.

text.p: Senate Budget Committee Chairman Pete Domenici said Friday President Clinton's nomination of Federico Pena for Energy Secretary may run into some trouble during the confirmation process in the Senate.
"I believe Secretary Pena may have some trouble being confirmed because he has little or no apparent experience in the major Energy Department missions," Domenici, R-NM, said in a statement.
Pena's nomination will first go through the Senate Energy Committee, of which Domenici is a member, and then be forwarded to the full Senate.
"I look forward to lengthy discussions with him (Pena) about the Department and hope he gives me reasons to support his nomination," Domenici said.
Energy industry officials were stunned by Clinton's decision to pick Pena, who was leaving his post as Transportation Secretary.
Just Thursday, Federal Energy Regulatory Commission chairwoman Elizabeth Moler had been expected to be Clinton's choice for Energy Secretary.
